title: Bears S Coby Bryant "wouldn't mind" returning to Seattle in season opener

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Bears S Coby Bryant "wouldn't mind" returning to Seattle in season opener
sources.description: Safety Coby Bryant's last game came as a member of the Seahawks and he'd be happy if his next one featured the Seahawks as his opponent.
